title: What Emerges and What Breaks in Self-Play Driving
abstract: arXiv:2608.30819v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training autonomous driving policies through pure self-play has recently shown promising results. Following Gigaflow and Puffer- Drive, we train driving policies in a similar self-play fashion, but extend the models from MLPs to Transformers and train on the high-definition map of a real city, where we ultimately aim to deploy them. On the CARLA and Waymax benchmarks, our policies fall short of Gigaflow, and we trace the gap to specific failure modes, including reward hacking at traffic lights and a missing incentive to stop at stop signs. We further analyze which traffic rules emerge from self-play and how closely they match human driving, and we confirm that reward conditioning yields the intended diversity of driving behaviors. A demonstration of a trained policy is available at https://laursisask-ut.github.io/eccvdemo.

translated_title: 自我博弈驾驶中的涌现与失效
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.30819v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：通过纯自我博弈训练自动驾驶策略近来展现出可喜的成果。继 Gigaflow 和 Puffer-Drive 之后，我们以类似的自我博弈方式训练驾驶策略，但将模型从多层感知机（MLP）扩展到 Transformer，并在一个真实城市的高精地图上进行训练——我们最终的目标正是在该城市部署这些策略。在 CARLA 和 Waymax 基准测试中，我们的策略未能达到 Gigaflow 的水平，我们将这一差距归因于特定的失效模式，包括在交通信号灯处的奖励投机（reward hacking）以及缺乏在停车标志前停车的激励。我们进一步分析了哪些交通规则会从自我博弈中涌现出来，以及它们与人类驾驶行为的匹配程度，并确认通过奖励条件化可以获得预期的驾驶行为多样性。训练好的策略演示可在 https://laursisask-ut.github.io/eccvdemo 观看。
tldr: 该研究将自我博弈驾驶策略训练从 MLP 扩展到 Transformer 并在真实城市高精地图上训练，发现其性能不及 Gigaflow，并系统揭示了涌现的交通规则与具体失效模式（如交通灯奖励投机和停车标志激励缺失）。
en_tdlr: This work extends self-play driving policy training from MLPs to Transformers on a real city's HD map, finds the policies underperform Gigaflow on CARLA and Waymax, and systematically analyzes which traffic rules emerge and which failure modes arise, such as reward hacking at traffic lights and missing incentives to stop at stop signs.
